# 🔍 Code Review Checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the issue.
- [ ] Algorithm definition and assumptions are explicit.
- [ ] Array shapes and types are checked.
- [ ] Input errors are handled safely.
- [ ] Random behavior is reproducible when required.
- [ ] Training and evaluation data are separated correctly.
- [ ] No claims exceed the measured evidence.
- [ ] No secrets or private data are introduced.
- [ ] Tests and docs updated.
- [ ] All relevant apps smoke-tested.
